text:
Sam (Growth): Thinking about a 25-30min micro-webinar for APAC-friendly hours. Goal: show pragmatic infra + cost wins. Need run-of-show, speaker order, and how leads flow to SDRs. Quick ideas?
Nina - Events: Love the short format. Suggest: 2x8min demos, 6m panel/QA, 2m intro, 2m close = 26m. Keep slides minimal. Live demo + recorded fallback for each.
Ethan (Design): I can make a 6-slide master: title, agenda, demo A (3 slides), demo B (3 slides), panel, CTA. Will do slide notes for speakers.
Rina (Eng Ops): For leads: registration should capture "deployment interest" (Hosted/Dedicated/Private) + "current monthly inference spend" (buckets). Map to SFDC with lead source = micro_web_apac_2026.
Sam (Growth): Nice. Add a hidden param: sample_workload = {chat/summ/embeddings} so Solutions can prioritize inbound.
Rina (Eng Ops): Will add sample_workload and demo_choice. Also propose an automated Slack notification to #sales-inbox for >$5k/month leads.
Nina - Events: Rehearsal cadence: tech check 20m before, full dress 48h before (30m), quick run at T-15. Can we run a 15-min recording of both demos as backup?
Ethan (Design): I'll export 16:9 slide deck and a 1-slide speaker prompt for each speaker. Who are confirmed speakers?
Sam (Growth): Confirmed: Priya (Platform PM), Jordan (Customer Ops), Mei (Infra). Moderator: me. Backup speaker: Jordan has a pre-recorded demo he can hand off.
Rina (Eng Ops): Oncall plan: Mei standby for infra; Jordan will have AWS creds ready; Priya will have a short pre-recorded segment if live model times out (90s). I'll create an incident channel for the slot.
FallbackBot: Scheduled cues set: T-48h reminder, T-30m mic check, T-10 switch-to-speaker, T-2 start-recording, T+1m post link to survey + resource deck.
Sam (Growth): Run-of-show draft: 0:00-0:02 intro (Sam), 0:02-0:10 Demo A (Priya), 0:10-0:18 Demo B (Jordan), 0:18-0:24 Panel (all), 0:24-0:26 CTA + survey. Let's keep 1-2 live screenshots per demo.
Nina - Events: I'll own invites, greenroom, and survey. Registration copy needs to promise a short benchmark takeaway + checklist. Can we write a 1-liner? Sam?
Sam (Growth): "Learn how teams cut per-token inference costs while keeping latency under 100ms — 25 minutes." Short and punchy.
Ethan (Design): Need 50-word bios for slides.
Priya (Platform): "Priya leads Platform Product at Redwood Inference; focuses on serving runtime optimizations and reliable deployment abstractions."
Jordan (Customer Ops): "Jordan heads Customer Solutions at Acme; implemented dedicated inference for low-latency customer-facing features." 
Mei (Infra): "Mei runs infra at ScaleOps; specializes in GPU orchestration and cost-aware autoscaling." 
Sam (Growth): Great. Quick marketing asks: add UTM params (utm_medium=webinar, utm_campaign=micro_web_apac), and include a CTA that links to a triage form that feeds tags.
Rina (Eng Ops): I'll wire Zapier -> SFDC -> Slack -> HubSpot flow and share mapping doc. SLA: SDR owner assigned within 12h for leads >$5k, otherwise 48h.
Nina - Events: Proposed rehearsal slots: Wed 02:00 UTC (full dress) and Fri 10:00 UTC (tech+quick run). Please RSVP in the calendar invite I just created.
Sam (Growth): Final owners: Nina (event ops + greenroom), Rina (lead routing + SLA), Ethan (deck + assets), Sam (moderator + copy). Anything else?
Mei (Infra): Will prepare a 90s prerecorded demo clip and a quick fallback script for the moderator.
Jordan (Customer Ops): I'll record a 2-min customer story clip as backup and provide the production metric to highlight.
Sam (Growth): Perfect. I'll draft registration copy + email reminders. Thanks team — pin the run-of-show once Nina uploads. :rocket:
